title: Local Residents Invited to Join Buena Vida Online Communities for Health and Wellness Support - NewsBreak
text:
2 minutes ago Social connections can play a role in supporting physical and mental health. The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention states that having a supportive network may help reduce the risk of chronic diseases and conditions such as heart disease, dementia, depression, and anxiety.
HealthSelect of Texas® and Consumer Directed HealthSelectSM members have access to the Buena Vida well-being platform. This platform offers several online communities to encourage connection and support. For example, the Be Active group promotes physical activity and sharing workout ideas. The Be Social group focuses on building social connections and sharing ways to stay engaged.
Other groups include Eat Well, where members share recipes and nutrition tips, and Healthy Weight, which supports members in managing their weight. Joyful Longevity addresses healthy aging. Sleep Tight and Stress Less provide spaces to discuss sleep and stress management.
The General Group is open to all Buena Vida members. It provides updates on program benefits and reminders. Members can join these communities by logging in to their Buena Vida account and selecting the groups that match their interests.
State of Texas employees can also join Fitness Connect and Nutrition Connect Communities. These offer monthly live sessions with Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Texas representatives. In December, employees can join Monday morning gratitude sessions. Research suggests these sessions may support mental health. Registration and event details are available on the Employees Retirement System of Texas website and Virtual Wellness Calendar.
